title: Is USB Type-C ACTUALLY Stronger?? Durability Test
summary: Linus Tech Tips tests whether USB Type-C connectors are more durable than Micro-B by repeatedly plugging and unplugging them. In the test, Micro-B failed at around 8000 insertions while USB-C kept working.
why: HN cites it whenever someone asks whether USB-C holds up better than micro USB, as a small sample but concrete test.

quote.text: Linus Tech Tips actually tested 10000 USB-C insertions
